selection: Purposive domain-diverse v1 panel; not a random sample. Eight inventory entries plus two additional sources.

seeds.label: Scanpy: PBMC3k clustering tutorial
seeds.focus: QC, cell/gene filtering and normalization; omit the full clustering and marker-discovery workflow.
seeds.inputs: 10x PBMC3k count matrix and feature/barcode files; stage before solving.

seeds.label: Harvard Bioinformatics Coffee Hour: bedtools
seeds.focus: Identify chr22 enhancers overlapping strand-aware upstream gene intervals, with an explicit duplicate/overlap contract.
seeds.inputs: Repository BED files and hg38.genome: about 276 KB total. Check genome-build consistency and source attribution.
seeds.input_origin: Published enhancer/peak examples and curated gene annotations; original dataset lineage still needs checking.

seeds.label: methylKit user guide
seeds.focus: Coverage filtering, joining CpG sites across four samples and comparing group methylation; use the bundled count-table section, not alignment or segmentation.
seeds.inputs: test1/test2/control1/control2.myCpG.txt; four files total about 374 KB.
seeds.input_origin: Bundled example counts; observed versus simulated origin unresolved. Do not label as observed without further evidence.

seeds.label: QFeatures: processing quantitative proteomics data
seeds.focus: Filter contaminants/missing values and aggregate a prepared peptide assay to proteins, using a specified aggregation contract.
seeds.inputs: CPTAC study 6 A/B peptide table from MsDataHub; six quantitative sample columns. Stage a documented subset if needed.
seeds.input_origin: Observed proteomics measurements, processed by MaxQuant; any subset is an adapted input.

seeds.label: MDAnalysis: RMSD of atomic structures
seeds.focus: Backbone alignment and CORE/LID/NMP domain RMSD summaries for the supplied adenylate-kinase trajectory.
seeds.inputs: MDAnalysisTests PSF/DCD inputs; stage a fixed frame subset if needed. No new molecular-dynamics simulation.
seeds.input_origin: Supplied simulated trajectory; structural reference lineage retained separately.

seeds.label: xcms: LC-MS preprocessing and analysis
seeds.focus: The final PCA section: missing-feature handling, log transformation and sample structure in a prepared feature-intensity table.
seeds.inputs: Derived feature table plus sample metadata from the vignette's eight faahKO samples; upstream preprocessing belongs to input preparation, not the solver attempt.
seeds.input_origin: Observed mouse LC-MS measurements with derived inputs. Record preprocessing and retain the technical-bias caveat.

seeds.label: COBRApy: simulating with FBA
seeds.focus: Compare biomass and ATP-maintenance objectives in the E. coli core model; grade objectives/feasibility rather than requiring one unique flux vector.
seeds.inputs: Local copy of the textbook model and a CPU solver; avoid broad flux sampling or expensive loopless analysis.
seeds.input_origin: Curated mechanistic model and computed predictions, not measured fluxes.

seeds.label: phyloseq: microbiome census analysis
seeds.focus: Per-sample richness and Shannon diversity from GlobalPatterns, joined correctly to sample metadata; avoid full ordination and plotting workflow.
seeds.inputs: Bundled GlobalPatterns count table and sample metadata.
seeds.input_origin: Observed community measurements; keep mock-community samples identified separately.

seeds.label: scikit-bio: basic bioinformatics (IL6)
seeds.focus: Pairwise evolutionary distances or neighbor-joining topology from a prepared IL6 protein alignment of seven species; omit visualization and full alignment construction.
seeds.inputs: Pinned il6.ffn and a reference-prepared alignment; record translation/alignment provenance. Verify APIs against the pinned environment.
seeds.input_origin: Reference coding sequences with derived protein alignment; sequence accession lineage needs recording.

seeds.label: PyRadiomics: two brain-image examples
seeds.focus: Compare a fixed set of original-image first-order and shape descriptors within supplied tumor masks.
seeds.inputs: brain1/brain2 images and masks from getTestCase, staged offline; fixed feature settings. No segmentation or broad filter-bank extraction.
seeds.input_origin: Source describes brain images with supplied tumor segmentations; retain original image and mask provenance.

rejected_candidates.reason: Archived source with CC-BY-NC-SA terms; selected the BSD-3-Clause scikit-bio tutorials notebook instead.
Inspection found simulated inputs and incomplete example cells; selected a more self-contained observed-sequence example.
